stories.body: Reproductive success across animal taxa relies on the unequivocal identification of volatile chemical cues used for sexual communication. stories.title: Modelling Metacognition: A Joint Prediction-Confidence Model for Predictive Inference Task Data

stories.title: WITHDRAWN: Oligodendroglia as functional effectors of Multiple Sclerosis risk variants

stories.title: RTTN moonlights beyond the centrosome to control ribosome biogenesis and tRNA modification in human brain organoids
stories.body: RTTN (rotatin) is a centrosomal protein mutated in severe malformations of cortical development, yet how its dysfunction disrupts human corticogenesis has remained unclear. stories.subject: plant biology
stories.title: C4 photosynthetic pathway fluxes in transgenic rice plants
stories.body: Most land plants photosynthesize using the C3 pathway, in which ribulose bisphosphate carboxylase/oxygenase (Rubisco) fixes CO2 into 3-carbon acids. stories.title: Iron export and lipid droplets shield deep-diving elephant seal cells from lipid peroxidation
